explication: IndexTTS-vLLM is a speech-synthesis application that replaces the IndexTTS GPT inference stage with vLLM for faster generation. A client submits text and optional reference audio through the API or web UI; inference prepares text and voice conditioning, generates acoustic tokens, converts them to audio features, and vocodes a waveform. The repository also documents v1/v1.5 multi-reference voice mixing and v2 emotion controls, plus OpenAI-compatible speech and voice-list APIs. The graph reflects documented capabilities and sampled inference/model code; some subsystem wiring is based on the README because its implementation was not sampled.
